xc_files.name: main.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
var $p = panel(top, 100, 40)
var $q = panel(top, 200, 40)
var $t = 0
var $hit = 0

tick
	$t = $t + 1
	if $t == 30
		$p.set_size(160, 60)
	if $t == 60
		$p.set_position(400, 200)
	$p.blank(black)
	$p.write(1, 1, cyan, text("{0}x{1}", $p.width, $p.height))
	if $p.button_rect(110, 40, 44, 16, green, color(30, 70, 30))
		$hit = $hit + 1
	if $hit > 0
		$p.write(1, 30, white, "HIT")
	$q.blank(black)
	$q.write(1, 1, white, "ANCHOR")
